name: canon
description: The practice brain. Tenets — how to build, each carrying the incidents that proved it, ratified by the firm — convictions, in their own words, that Count Bassy challenges from and never from its own opinion, and eighteen standing behaviours for how a session conducts itself, with a docket that hands back what is open and what needs deciding as a form the firm fills in. Mines a corpus and adopts a repository by proposing, never writing. Holds no client data, mirrors no project's code.
